title: Rust re-adding an unchanged peer resets its replay window
description: rust/lichen-link LinkLayer.add_peer always replaces the tracked entry and calls replay.reset_peer on the replaced public key, even when IID and public key are unchanged. Production announcement handling calls add_peer for accepted peers, so a signed announcement/data frame can advance replay state, trigger same-key re-add, erase that state, and then be replay-accepted. Preserve generation/replay/pin state for idempotent same-key refresh; only atomic authenticated key replacement may retire/reset state. Add exact replay-after-reannounce and retained-evidence liveness tests.
